WGU Single Courses

Individual university courses without admission to a full degree. Discounted prices, recurring extensions and assessments vary by course; an outside college decides how a completed course applies.

Build my degree plan

Choose a degree plan to see where specific courses fit.

Study format
Self-paced within a two- or three-month initial access period, depending on the course. Continued access is billed automatically unless cancelled; assessment deadlines and eligibility vary.
Pricing
WGU advertises discounted $25 single courses and $49 bundles, while its November 2026 catalog lists standard single-course prices of $750–$1,000. Exact discount eligibility is unresolved. Most extensions are $99/month; the PACA + IT & Tech bundle extension is $199/month. Federal financial aid is unavailable.
Assessments
Applied Algebra (C957A) and Organizational Behavior (C715A) require proctored exams. The retrieved English Composition I syllabus describes four papers; Introduction to Communication (D268A) describes three final projects. Assessment examples are course-specific; there is no universal no-proctor claim.
Credit type
Completed courses can appear on an official WGU transcript. Exact credit units and course codes follow the course syllabus. External receiving-course equivalencies are not established by matching titles or removing a code suffix.
Transfer and enrollment details

How the credit works

Completed courses can appear on an official WGU transcript. Exact credit units and course codes follow the course syllabus. External receiving-course equivalencies are not established by matching titles or removing a code suffix.

Before enrolling

  • Start with your degree plan to see the proposed receiving course or requirement.
  • Review any course-specific enrollment, equipment or assessment steps shown in your plan.
  • University decisions about your own records remain separate from published course matches.
